properties.note: Built-up = where heavy black ink (block fronts drawn as bands at least 15 m thick, solid blocks; not road casings, thin block outlines, railways, lettering) covers more than 22 % of the ground within 80 m: about 40 % of a block's frontage built. Fully built blocks read 0.55-0.65, Central Park 0.01. Closed across streets (40 m); parts under 1.5 ha dropped, holes under 1 ha filled; piers beyond 60 m from a street of today and ink on today's railways left out. The sheets were used as georeferenced by USGS (NAD27 polyconic -> UTM 18N): against today's streets they sit within about 20-40 m (read by eye on four crops; automatic matching did not converge on these sheets), so edges are good to about one short block. Year: USGS record gives 1889 as the start of the content date range of the 1891 editions (first survey); the collar was not read. Mott Haven, Melrose, Morrisania, Tremont, Fordham, West Farms ... (the 23rd and 24th wards) as parts.
properties.method: heavy black ink share on the sheet (tools/usgs_extent.py), clipped to the borough (TIGER 2024 county + 150 m)
